Stephani Comitis Palatini, Ducis Bavariæ, & Bipontis Veldentii & Sponhemii Comitis, Abnepotibus Majoribus.

Wolfgangi Wilhelmi, & Johannis Comitum Palatinorum Rheni, Bavariæ, Iuliæ, Cliviæ, Montium Ducum, Veldentianorum, Sponheimiorum, Marcanorum, Ravensburgiorum Comitum, Dynastarum Ravensteinio-rum filiis primogenitis & successoribus.
main_text.head: PHILIPPO WILHELMO ET FRIDERICO,
main_text.p: Comitibus Palatinis Rheni, Bavariæ, Iuliæ, Cliviæ, Montium Ducibus, Veldentiis, Sponheimiis, Marcanis, Ravensburgiis Comitibus, Dynastis Ravensteiniis, Principibus ac Dominis suis gratiosissimis.
main_text.head: Vita & Incolumitas.
main_text.p: ET vobis quoque Principes Illustrissimi, Juliam, Cliviam, Montiam, Marchiam, Ravensburgiam, Ravensteiniam, ex quo stemmate clarissimo simul & antiquissimo ob Avias Annam & Magdalenam, Wilhelmi Iuliæ Cliviæ Montium Ducis potentissimi secundam & tertiam filias originem maternam trahitis, dedicatum eo, adeoque cum Serenissimo C. V. nepote Friderico-Wilhelmo

page.notes: The running head is a decorative ornament rather than legible text; the running_head value is a best reading. The first column of the Latin text is set in italic in its final paragraph and the drop capital "E" is a woodcut initial. Catchword and signature are as printed at the foot.
